description: This file defines classes and functions related to symbolic tracing in PyTorch's FX module, including Proxy classes, tracer base classes, scope management, and argument handling for graph construction.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Tracks module path and type for nodes in FX graph.

classes.name: ScopeContextManager
classes.description: Manages scope context during symbolic tracing.

classes.name: TracerBase
classes.description: Base class for tracers, manages graph node creation and argument handling.

classes.name: GraphAppendingTracer
classes.description: Tracer used for appending nodes to a graph without full tracing.

classes.name: TraceError
classes.description: Custom error class for tracing errors.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Wraps a Node to record operations during symbolic tracing.

classes.name: MetaProxy
classes.description: Proxy subclass that propagates metadata during graph tracing.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Proxy for attribute access, lazily creates nodes.

classes.name: ParameterProxy
classes.description: Proxy for module parameters, exposes shape, size, etc.

methods.name: create_node
methods.description: Inserts a graph node with specified target, args, kwargs.

methods.name: create_proxy
methods.description: Creates a node and returns it wrapped in a Proxy.

methods.name: create_arg
methods.description: Converts objects into arguments suitable for graph nodes.

methods.name: to_bool
methods.description: Handles conversion of proxy to boolean, raises error if used in control flow.

methods.name: iter
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the proxy, raises error if unsupported.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns keys of a proxy object.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Wraps a node in a Proxy.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Creates a call node for method invocation.

methods.name: __abs__
methods.description: Creates a node for abs operation.

methods.name: __bool__
methods.description: Converts proxy to boolean, with special handling for assertions.
